title: eriobotrya buisanensis
intro: Eriobotrya buisanensis, commonly known as the Korean loquat or Buisan loquat, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Eriobotrya buisanensis include antioxidant activity, which helps to protect cells from oxidative stress, and anti-inflammatory activity, which helps to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Eriobotrya buisanensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
